rationale: iter-8 IteratedResidualStack K=2 (port main iter-25 / spawn-B iter-2 6-block c=32 resnet, share weights, K=2). Timed out at 8:11 after only 3 epochs (loss converging nicely at 0.00039). Full-res 6-block resnet x2 is ~2x the compute of K=2 U-Net; doesn't fit 5-min wall. Next: K=2 + n_blocks=4 to shrink the per-pass cost.
advice_for_others: Iterated residual stack with shared weights costs 2x per pass; halve n_blocks to keep total compute fixed when adding an extra unroll step.
